pathConvention: Paths belong to the indicated owning repository; proposed files and CLI-generated migration names are targets, not claims that files already exist. Unresolved owner aliases are explicit contract-assignment tasks.

packages.title: Baseline, contracts and branch reconciliation
packages.completionGate: Exact heads and contract fixtures recorded; paired Library visibility failure reproduced and corrected without weakening privacy assertions.

packages.title: Canonical inventory and compatibility resolver
packages.completionGate: All approved launch destinations accounted for across Apps, shortcuts and search; legacy aliases survive and staged/private destinations remain gated.

packages.title: Practical shortcut management
packages.completionGate: New apps can be pinned/reordered from Apps or a simple editor without starting a layout draft; safe external shortcuts and migration are verified.

packages.title: Command boundary, selectors and safe schema expansion
packages.completionGate: Single writer preserved; v1 data, fields and IDs survive transactional migration; incompatible older writers stop safely; realistic document budgets checked.

packages.title: Account qualification and app session adoption
packages.completionGate: Required CI and owner-authorized sign-in, refresh, two-device identity and opt-out checks pass before account capabilities are released.

packages.title: Durable sync, recovery and lifecycle completion
packages.completionGate: Offline/retry/conflict/quota/retention and deletion tests preserve owner data and recoverability; upgrades and rollback remain schema compatible.

packages.title: One Hub shell and navigation lifecycle
packages.completionGate: Every Hub surface uses consistent shell/focus/history/privacy; trusted reading-host and necessary full-document boundaries remain intact.

packages.title: Connection center and safe diagnostics
packages.completionGate: All app capabilities, freshness and repair actions are truthful; diagnostics exclude secrets and private content; recovery controls work on mobile.

packages.title: Provider runtime and full app capability matrix
packages.completionGate: Every app has an owner/capability/evidence decision; bounded provider results pass ownership, revocation, expiry, cancellation and partial-failure tests.

packages.title: Genuine continuation and cross-app activity
packages.completionGate: Authorized native changes resume the exact supported resource/context, with correct return state, deduplicated activity and honest fallback.

packages.title: Unified capture and consistent task Inbox
packages.completionGate: Capture destination is explicit; Inbox/Today/Upcoming counts agree; offline native commands use durable receipts without double submission.

packages.title: Scheduling, Focus and reviewed follow-through
packages.completionGate: Capture-to-schedule-to-focus-to-review uses the same records; undo and explicit carry-forward preserve task/event ownership.

packages.title: Native calendar and external read-only coverage
packages.completionGate: Day/week, recurrence, DST and ICS limits/deduplication work; native versus read-only source ownership and freshness are explicit.

packages.title: Useful widgets, approachable layout and mobile Today
packages.completionGate: Dense/empty/populated layouts and mobile agenda are useful; existing keyboard/touch editing, named layouts, privacy and unknown widgets remain safe.

packages.title: Tracking, habits and source-backed progress
packages.completionGate: Habits, goal changes and imported/manual measurements preserve units, day boundaries and corrections without duplicated events.

packages.title: One search and action palette
packages.completionGate: One accessible palette finds current apps and allowed records/actions; private queries stay private; offline local results and cancellation work.

packages.title: Attention Inbox with real outcomes
packages.completionGate: Real issues are grouped/deduplicated; supported dismiss/snooze/resolve has native read-back; unavailable data is never presented as zero issues.

packages.title: Reminder policy and optional notifications
packages.completionGate: Due/quiet-hours/permission/duplicate-delivery behavior is tested; inactive-page or background limitations are stated honestly.

packages.title: Combined acceptance, release and operations
packages.completionGate: All ten acceptance journeys pass at the final exact head with distinct synthetic/owner evidence, truthful capabilities, safe rollback and production smoke.
